description: Drop `GET /v1/assets/{planId}/{filename}`. The spec declares the 200 body as `image/jpeg` or `image/png` (`type: string, format: binary`). The converter reads only JSON or `application/octet-stream` bodies, so the operation would generate an empty `{}` output and the REST protocol would decode the image bytes as text. A method that returns corrupt data is worse than none. Source: the operation's `responses.200.content` in the published InnerSpace 1.3.23 OpenAPI document. The service's `operations` list drops the removed shapes itself (finalizeConvert's syncServiceOperations), so no patch addresses it by position.
